name: Mihon Harmony Preview v0.21.2-harmony-preview.9
body:
基于 [Mihon v0.21.2](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.2) 的非官方 HarmonyOS / 卓易通 兼容构建 (nightly 构建类型)。

## 本构建包含的补丁

- `0001-downloads-rename-fallback-for-saf-without-renamedocument.patch`: downloads: fall back to copy+delete when SAF renameDocument is unsupported
- `0002-updater-use-harmony-fork-releases.patch`: updater: check this fork's GitHub releases for -harmony-preview builds
- `0003-downloads-cbz-temp-in-private-cache.patch`: downloads: keep CBZ temp files in the private cache, tolerate stale archives
- `0005-downloads-background-keep-alive-silent-audio.patch`: downloads: keep the process alive in the background on HarmonyOS (silent audio + wake lock)
- `0006-downloads-notification-speed-and-progress.patch`: downloads: Animeko-style progress notification with speed and progress
- `0007-updater-delete-installed-apk.patch`: updater: delete the installed update APK at startup
- `0008-updater-release-mirror.patch`: updater: read the release list from the repo-branch mirror first
- `0010-downloads-finalize-with-fewer-saf-copies-and-error-reasons.patch`: downloads: finish chapters with fewer SAF copies and show why a download failed
- `0011-downloads-never-skip-silently-reuse-or-replace-leftover-folders.patch`: downloads: never drop a chapter silently; reuse or replace folders left on disk
- `0012-crash-log-filter-harmony-noise-and-keep-app-log.patch`: =?UTF-8?q?crash=20log:=20filter=20=E5=8D=93?= =?UTF-8?q?=E6=98=93=E9=80=9A=20graphics=20noise=20and=20keep=20the=20app'?= =?UTF-8?q?s=20own=20log=20lines?=
- `0013-downloads-retried-failed-chapters-are-not-skipped.patch`: downloads: do not report a retried failed chapter as "already in the queue"
- `0014-library-panorama-comfortable-grid-display-mode.patch`: library: add a panorama comfortable grid display mode (wide covers, staggered layout)
- `0015-library-panorama-compact-grid-display-mode.patch`: library: add a panorama compact grid display mode
- `0016-presentation-staggered-fast-scroller-steady-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast scroller thumb steady
- `0017-updater-pick-highest-harmony-version.patch`: updater: pick the highest harmony version instead of the first listed
- `0018-library-panorama-stable-cell-shapes.patch`: library: keep panorama cell shapes stable while scrolling
- `0019-library-panorama-settle-debounce-browse-prefetch.patch`: library: wait for the panorama grid to really stop and learn browse shapes ahead
- `0020-presentation-staggered-scroller-stable-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast-scroll thumb from stepping back once a row
- `0021-presentation-panorama-masonry-reading-order.patch`: presentation: lay panorama cells left to right unless a lane is recessed by half
- `0022-updater-retry-and-resume-the-update-download.patch`: updater: retry and resume the update download
- `0023-presentation-panorama-auto-columns-span.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns fit book covers and wide covers span two lanes
- `0024-presentation-panorama-scroll-anchor-by-key.patch`: presentation: panorama grid saves its scroll anchor by key
- `0025-presentation-panorama-layout-epoch.patch`: presentation: panorama layout skips per-item work while content is unchanged
- `0026-library-panorama-cover-shapes-versioned.patch`: library: panorama cover shapes notify per version, not per map read
- `0027-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller thumb stays grabbed while pressed
- `0028-presentation-panorama-tiered-auto-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns widen on large windows
- `0029-presentation-fast-scroller-snapshotflow.patch`: presentation: fast scroller follows scroll without restarting per frame
- `0030-presentation-panorama-shaped-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns follow the shelf's dominant cover shape
- `0031-library-panorama-shape-mode.patch`: library: panorama grids pick tall or wide columns from committed cover shapes
- `0032-presentation-fast-scroller-thumb-hitbox.patch`: presentation: fast scroller hit box stays on the drawn thumb
- `0033-presentation-panorama-scroll-trace.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll trace in the crash log dump
- `0034-presentation-panorama-exact-scroll-delta.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll reports the exact delta it applied
- `0035-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-to-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller grabs on the thumb or on a hold beside it

## 安装说明

- 下载 `mihon-v0.21.2-harmony-preview.9-arm64-v8a.apk`（华为设备均为 arm64）。
- 包名为 `app.mihon.debug`，与官方正式版 `app.mihon` 是两个独立应用，可以共存；harmony-preview 版本之间可直接覆盖安装。
- 设置 → 高级 → 扩展安装器 选「Private」，扩展会装进 App 自己的目录，不再受卓易通安装限制。
- 应用内更新会检查本仓库的 Release，而不是官方更新服务器。
- 建议开启 设置 → 下载 →「保存为 CBZ」：目录模式下下载中的图片会被鸿蒙图库索引。
